comment: C keeps one glyph buffer for the screen, not one per level. Returning to level 1 after the troll corpse's timer has run out, goto_level()'s run_timers() newsym()s the corpse's square before docrt(); show_glyph() compares the remembered corpse with level 2's glyph still in the buffer, so mention_map announces it, and pager.c object_from_map() makes a stand-in corpse to name it.
